correctness.rationale: The paper defines rank 1/2 for two neighbors and 3 for remaining unmatched. A two-rank improvement is possible only for a currently unmatched endpoint choosing its favorite. Thus blocking requires the exact local forbidden five-bit pattern. The six-state closed-walk encoding is bijective on labeled cycles of all n>=3, with correct size exponent. Independent symbolic determinant establishes lambda^4((lambda-1)^2-4z); eigenvalue power traces and binomial coefficient comparison yield all n,j. Code independently tests original rank-based definition for n=3..11; checks are corroboration, not the infinite proof.

value.rationale: The new rank-distance approximate stability model motivates distinguishing multiplicity from existence on low-degree nonbipartite topologies. The result yields the entire exact size distribution (annealed first-moment polynomial), not a single small numeric instance. The exponential expected multiplicity rate and parity correction contrast mere guaranteed existence and give a baseline for stochastic cycle modeling; this is a natural family and invariant rather than an arbitrary parameter slice. The result does not require a downstream theorem.
